children: LG Energy Solution's energy storage system shipments are expected to surge in North America next year, Yuanta Securities Korea's Lee An-na and Bae Jong-sung say. The analysts expect the South Korean battery maker's ESS shipments in the region to jump to 53-60 gigawatt hours in 2027 from 39-44GWh in 2026, citing large customers including Tesla and Terra-Gen. LG's ESS production capacity there is likely to rise to 55-65GWh in 2027 from 50GWh in 2026, they say. LG is boosting production of ESS lithium iron phosphate batteries at its factories in Michigan, as it shifts electric-vehicle battery assembly lines to ESS battery production. (kwanwoo.jun@wsj.com)
